annotations.title: Confirm a draft source archive upload

description: After the signed PUT succeeds, verify and attach the archive to the owned draft. Confirm that the Builder accepted "I own or have the rights to sell the codebase I am about to upload."; pass ownershipAccepted=true and ownershipVersion=2026-09-27. The server records the accepted wording with the source change. Final review and publishing stay in the web wizard.

contentType.description: Archive MIME type, used unchanged for PUT and confirmation.

objectKey.description: Storage key returned by z2h_request_source_upload. Pass it unchanged.

ownershipAccepted.description: True only after the Builder explicitly accepts the statement in this tool description.

ownershipVersion.description: Version of the ownership statement explicitly accepted by the Builder.

sizeBytes.description: Exact archive size in bytes. Must match the uploaded file.

slug.description: Owned listing slug from z2h_list_my_listings or z2h_create_draft_listing.

name: z2h_confirm_source_upload

ok.description: The archive was verified and attached, or this same archive was already attached. Publishing remains in the web wizard.

title: Confirm a draft source archive upload
